messages:
Sasha (Design): quick review of the export mapping presets + keyboard-first CSV mapping in the vectors preview. added frames in Figma: https://figma.com/file/preset-mapping
Omar (Frontend): skimmed. what's the single biggest risk we need to fix for keyboard users?
Sasha (Design): mapping grid isn't keyboard navigable right now. users can't tab into sample preview cells; dropdown presets get clipped on narrow windows. copy also unclear: 'Export CSV — choose columns' feels buried.
Mei (A11y): agree. mapping view should be a semantic table with focusable cells. arrow-key nav for the grid, enter to edit a cell. announce mapping changes with aria-live. presets need descriptive labels and aria-describedby for tooltips.
Priya (PM): product ask: default preset = "embedding_only" and default format = JSONL. make it easy to save a mapping as a preset. when applying a preset, show a small status: "Preset applied: Embedding + title" and a preview row.
Raj (Backend): we can store presets per-user. API: POST /v1/users/:id/presets {name,mapping} and GET returns list. export endpoint already accepts mapping object. fine to persist.
Omar (Frontend): plan: convert mapping UI to a tabbable table, add arrow-key navigation, editable selects for column sources. implement an accessible preset dropdown in toolbar to avoid clipping in modal body.
Sasha (Design): CTA copy proposal: primary: "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)" secondary: "Export CSV — map columns" tertiary (in-modal): "Save mapping as preset". small helper text: "Preview updates as you map columns." keep it terse.
Mei (A11y): accessibility nits: don't rely on color only to indicate active mappings; add a focus ring and aria-pressed state. also relevance-score pill contrast still falls below 4.5:1 in the current frames for small text — propose darken or add outline.
Priya (PM): UX decision: if a user applies a preset and then edits it, show "Unsaved changes" and surface "Save" and "Revert" actions. also allow applying a recent mapping when opening modal.
Raj (Backend): one more backend detail: for large CSV exports (>5000 rows) we'll queue a background job and email a link when complete. also adding an export-preview endpoint that returns the first 5 rows given a mapping is straightforward.
Omar (Frontend): I'll add an aria-live message like "Mapping applied: title -> csv_column_1" on apply and ensure modal close returns focus to the toolbar preset button. also add keyboard tooltip for truncated preview cells and a copy-to-clipboard icon with aria-label="Copy full value".
DeployBot: deploy:design-preview updated with latest figma frames. :rocket:
Sasha (Design): great. next steps: Omar implements keyboard grid + aria-live, Raj implements presets endpoints + preview, Mei to draft a short a11y checklist for the PR, Priya to confirm final CTA copy. back Monday for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
